name: Eric Gitangu
title: Software Engineer, Payments Platforms and Distributed Systems
subtitle: Backend, platform and security engineering for payment systems in Africa
tagline: Backend and platform engineer for payment systems that run in production
summary: Software engineer with 11 years in production systems, the last five in African fintech, mobility and energy access. I currently own platform architecture and data security for a mobility and payments company: five web applications and a mobile API on one backend, 6,800 unit tests, 280 architecture decision records, an atomic release process with automatic rollback, and card and mobile money integrations (Mastercard Payment Gateway Services, M-Pesa, MTN, Tigo) built within PCI DSS SAQ-A scope. Before that I ran CI/CD and test automation for a pay-as-you-go solar platform in seven countries, founded an ML security company for medical device software, and led a digital addressing pilot with a county government. I work in TypeScript, Java, PHP, Python, Rust, Go and C#. I design event-driven systems, plan for failure, and instrument what I ship. I set technical direction for the team, review code daily, and have mentored 15 engineers.
